Requirement Statement: The portal shall provide a Django web application with organizations, users, authentication, and an admin interface.
Notes: Portal uses Django auth and custom PortalUser model.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall enforce organization membership and active subscription or trial status before allowing client access.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/accounts/api.py: portal_login_required; web_portal/accounts/models.py: PortalUser, Organization, UserSubscription.
Notes: Session validation and daily subscription checks are enforced.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall allow only one active portal session per user at a time.
The system shall support username/password login, Google/SSO-style external identity login, and email code sign-in.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/accounts/api.py: sign_in, request_email_code, verify_email_code, ExternalIdentity; web_portal/accounts/models.py.
Notes: Multiple sign-in methods exist for different user types.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall model subscription plans, seat purchases, plan validity windows, and access expiry.
Notes: Billing logic is simulation-based but structured as real subscription objects.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall maintain organization-level records such as access type, address, contact person, subscription state, and validity period.
Notes: Each portal user belongs to an organization.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall let an organization manage its customers and maintain customer records within the organization.
Notes: Customer records are names scoped to an organization.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall maintain invention records for each customer and assign each invention a numbered version history.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/patents/models.py: Invention, InventionVersion; web_portal/patents/api.py: create_invention, add_version.
Notes: Each invention contains a versioned IDF submission history.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall accept UTF-8 .txt IDF files up to 10 MB through the portal and validate extension and encoding.
Notes: Only .txt files and UTF-8 are accepted for v1.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall store each uploaded IDF as a versioned artifact and trigger analysis on submission.
Notes: Analysis is triggered through the backend FastAPI service.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall call the FastAPI /predict service by posting the IDF and session_id, then store the JSON result and report path.
Notes: The portal treats FastAPI as a private backend dependency.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall allow downloading only completed analysis reports that belong to the current organization’s invention versions.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/patents/api.py: download_report; report path validation against FASTAPI_REPORT_ROOT.
Notes: Security check ensures report path stays within the allowed root.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall enforce CSRF, secure cookies, and strict host / trusted-origin configuration for browser security.
Notes: Production settings secure the app against browser abuse.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall store uploaded IDFs and generated reports outside the database in configured media and report directories.
Notes: File storage is deliberately separate from the DB.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall support local SQLite and production PostgreSQL configuration via DATABASE_URL.
The portal shall be a React frontend served via Nginx, with Django acting as the API/admin layer.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/README.md: Production topology section, Nginx serving static UI and proxying /api/ and /admin/.
Notes: This is the intended architecture for deployment.

Requirement Statement: The system shall support local development with separate FastAPI, Django, and React processes.
Notes: This mirrors the multi-process local dev topology.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall separate administration from client portal access and prevent superuser accounts from entering the portal.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/accounts/api.py: portal_login_required checks for is_superuser; web_portal/README.md.
Notes: Admin users are distinct from portal users.

Requirement Statement: The portal shall keep file and report paths out of the browser response and expose only the necessary record metadata.
Evidence / Source: web_portal/patents/api.py: _run_analysis strips idf_text and session_id from payload and stores report_path separately.
Notes: This reduces leakage of internal file paths.
